comment: RugSnare drift-watch corpus (research chat, 3-day cadence). 'pinned' = approved baseline contract; 'lastSeen' = latest version already graded; 'lastFindings' = findings count at last diff (for delta tracking). Each run: npm view latest; if > lastSeen -> install pinned, rugsnare scan, install latest, rugsnare diff; update docs/servers/<name>.md + this manifest. Dummy env values are for contract capture only, never call real APIs. Advance a pin deliberately, never silently.
